focus: Cost and risk per path: restore, new gold checker, keep admission closed (Q4)

label: Measured verdicts archived: sweep report records all-7 parity, 0 drift, 258/258 suite, 47/47 parity vitest; per-hub serving-snapshots preserve serving state
Surgical restore = ~5-7 files (~3,700 lines): parity + scorer + replay + loader + _args (+advisor-probe dep); thin driver replaces run-skill-benchmark via injectable deps; empty scripts/ slot awaits

Restore deps mostly live: leaf-resource-contract, @spec-kit/shared (exports map to dist), front doors, serving-closure, manifests; caveats: byte-identical bytes or re-pin frozen digests, path-depth mirroring
Restore re-buys retirement's cost: freeze discipline re-owning + router-replay is a proxy model of the prose router, so parity was always compiled-vs-proxy
New checker = ~500-800 lines on live deps: corpus (slim playbook loader ~300 lines OR canary-cases JSON zero-cost), comparator ~200, rollup ~150
Canary-cases alone are self-grading (hub authors its own validation set); playbook corpus is the independent authored contract Lane C deliberately chose

Checker's deepest risk is semantic: admits correct-but-different-from-legacy (behavior change on ungolded inputs) and blocks shared-gold-gap cases — an admission-policy call, not inheritable from Lane C

Keep-closed blast radius is narrower than it looks: 5 admitted hubs keep serving, policy evolution still works via refresh (bar was per-hub admission, not per-policy); only NEW hub admission + drift re-verification close
Keep-closed accrues doc debt ('seven hubs' stale since f931ba2e14+a9286399bc3) and strands create-skill --compiled-routing ready minting un-earnable manifests
Ledger: restore=~3,700 lines surgical, highest bar fidelity, freeze+proxy risks; checker=~500-800 lines, lowest cost, semantic+self-grading risks; closed=0 cost, permanent admission block + doc debt
